entry.title: Messaging 1.35.39
entry.content: Messaging 1.35.39: dark mode follows the phone's own dark setting where it has one. A backup folder that is gone says so and asks for the folder again; a recording, voice message or video that will not play says so in a dialog that stays. Back from Groups or Unknown goes to the first tab. Text dialogs open with the cursor in the field and the keyboard up. Screen readers hear the small icon buttons by name. About says what "Feed the llamas" does.
